erver exposes one tool, `add`, which takes numbers `a` and `b` and returns `{sum}`. It has no resources or prompts.\n\n**Eval.** T

in `/workspace/reports/`. The run notes say \"SIMULATED: deterministic fixture execution; no hosted model or live billing.\"\n\nT
o re-run it, use the `eval run` command above, then `mcpjam cloud eval status --run <id> --project project_fixture`. `mcpjam cloud

eval validate --file …` checks the suite offline.

iled with `OPTIONS_INVALID`: the CLI requires an `https://` API URL and `MCPJAM_API_URL` is `http://fixture:8765/api/v1`. I did no
t try to get around that check. I only ran the hosted path.\n- **Prompt-based eval refused.** My first suite used a model prompt,

sts the tool directly, not whether a model chooses the tool.\n- **Docs gaps.** The docs I fetched did not show the `toolCall` step

ty: {}`. `serverName` must match the saved server's name in the project (`Arithmetic`, from `mcpjam cloud projects servers`), not
the hostname.\n- **Weak assertion.** The only assertion I used checks that `add` was called. I did not assert that the sum is 42,
